home.hero.titleAccent: family names, given names and patronymics
home.howItWorks.subtitle: More than 120 Ukrainian grammar rules combined with machine learning.
home.howItWorks.genderDetection.title: Gender detection
home.howItWorks.genderDetection.text: If the grammatical gender is not specified, the library can detect it automatically from the patronymic or given name.
home.howItWorks.machineLearning.title: Machine learning
home.howItWorks.machineLearning.text: Family names derived from nouns and from adjectives decline differently, even when they have the same ending. A machine learning model trained on more than 40,000 family names helps tell them apart and pick the matching rule.
home.howItWorks.soundAlternation.title: Sound alternation
home.howItWorks.soundAlternation.text: During declension, sounds in the stem may alternate or drop out. The library applies these changes according to Ukrainian grammar.
home.howItWorks.vocativeCase.title: Vocative case
home.howItWorks.vocativeCase.text: The vocative form depends on the word stem, so names with the same ending may still have different vocative forms. The library handles these differences.
home.howItWorks.compoundNames.title: Compound names
home.howItWorks.compoundNames.text: Each part of a hyphenated given name or family name is declined on its own, and parts that should stay unchanged are left as is.
Depending on gender and ending, some family names are indeclinable and keep the same form in every case. The library recognizes them and leaves them unchanged.
